failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: The answer did not fill the requested slot: agents returned a related person or institution, or selected evidence matching only part of the clue.

rejected_edits.content: - Identify the answer slot before using the context: determine whether the clue asks for an entity, attribute, role, or relation, and return the value that fills that slot rather than a related entity. Parse relational wording carefully (for example, a clue about the university of a territory may ask for the territory, not the university). A person or entity introduced as an example (such as after “like”) may indicate a category or role rather than be the answer. Treat fragments as implicit questions and infer the missing value instead of narrating about the named subject; use a true/false answer only when explicitly requested.
rejected_edits.target: - Identify the specific entity, attribute, or relation requested before answering. Treat clue-like statements or fragments as implicit questions and return the missing value, not a judgment about whether the statement is true. Give the named referent rather than a related person, description, or broad topic; use a true/false answer only when explicitly requested.

rejected_edits.content: - Return one concise, standalone answer at exactly the requested level of specificity, not a full sentence or explanation. For fill-in or clue-style prompts, supply the missing value, but preserve every word that belongs to the established canonical name or title even if the clue also uses a generic category word. For definition clues, give the requested category term rather than a list of examples, and match grammatical number and necessary articles. For personal names, use the conventional form best supported by the context and requested specificity; do not automatically expand a surname-form answer into a full given name unless the fuller name is needed to identify the person or is requested. When a clue supplies part of a name and asks for completion, give only the missing component. Avoid explanations and alternatives.
rejected_edits.target: - Return one concise canonical answer at exactly the requested level of specificity. For fill-in or clue-style prompts, supply only the missing headword or name component; do not repeat information already given in the clue or add clue modifiers unless they are part of the canonical answer. For definition clues, give the requested category term rather than a list of examples, and match grammatical number and necessary articles. Use a full canonical personal name when the clue does not supply a name component; when it supplies part of a name and asks for completion, give only the missing component. Avoid explanations and alternatives.
